About

A little beyond the work.

I study economics at Stanford, with interests in computer science and philosophy. I like understanding how people think, what they value, and how an idea becomes useful.

Writing & ideas

I wrote Philosoteen for the Los Altos Town Crier, exploring philosophy in everyday life. I also co-authored Stanford’s winning 2026 policy memo on learning and assessment in the age of AI.
